corrections.reason: Improve compensate semantic equivalence and context
Clarify insurer deductible example
Shipping is not equivalent to on-time arrival
Explicit priority status and remove unsupported no-notice phrase
Clarify eligibility threshold vs actual express shipping
Scheduled window end is not guaranteed system restoration
A contingency is a possible future event; a contingency plan is a response arrangement, not an unqualified synonym for contingency itself.
Enclosure means something included with a letter or an area surrounded by a fence, not the physical fence itself.
competitive pricing: relative comparison with rival quotes, not merely subjectively attractive
efficient requires achieving results without wasting resources; productive is not an unconditional synonym
respondent answers a request/questionnaire; participant can include non-respondents
subscription is a regular payment for a product/service, not necessarily membership
credential in login credentials includes authentication information, while also possessing qualification senses
profit margin represents revenue minus associated costs and is often presented as a percentage
troubleshoot includes seeking ways to resolve a malfunction, beyond diagnosis alone
make cancellation fee example explicitly conditional on cancellation after deadline; avoid confusing late changes with cancellation
hotel occupancy rate uses occupied/sold rooms divided by available room inventory, not vague utilization
higher conference attendance refers to the number of attendees, not just fact of presence
a bid for work names a contractual price offer, not an unrestricted offer
subcontractor carries out part of another party's original obligation; outside contractor alone is overbroad
utility services include gas and water, not just electricity and water
keyboard-accessibility example concerns disability-inclusive website use rather than mere ease of access
airport shuttle makes recurring trips; a generic transfer bus need not do so
commute is a repeated home-work journey, not simply any trip to work
hotel amenity can be a service such as Wi-Fi, not just a physical guest facility
roster can include duties or work shifts, which the weekend-shift example requires
